title: Degrees of Freedom in Multi-Agent Coordination: Between Centralized and Decentralized Regimes
abstract: arXiv:2610.17751v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Large language model (LLM)-based multi-agent systems (MAS) are commonly organized around two coordination regimes. Centralized coordination provides explicit control but can create a bottleneck at a single coordination locus, whereas decentralized coordination offers local autonomy but must achieve effective collaboration through distributed decisions and experience. These trade-offs motivate a systematic study of the space between the two regimes. We introduce Degrees of Freedom (DoF), a continuous configuration framework that quantifies the size of the decision space delegated to downstream agents. DoF controls the granularity of delegated work and the target probability that each task unit is assigned to the branches. Its endpoints recover the two coordination regimes. translated_title: 多智能体协调中的自由度：介于集中式与去中心化机制之间
translated_abstract: 基于大语言模型（LLM）的多智能体系统（MAS）通常围绕两种协调机制来组织。集中式协调提供显式的控制，但可能在单一协调节点处造成瓶颈；而去中心化协调提供了局部自主性，但必须通过分布式决策和经验来实现有效的协作。这些权衡促使我们对这两种机制之间的空间进行系统性研究。我们引入了自由度，这是一个连续的配置框架，用于量化委派给下游智能体的决策空间的大小。DoF 控制着委派工作的粒度，以及每个任务单元被分配到各分支的目标概率。该框架的两个端点分别对应于集中式与去中心化这两种协调机制。在多个任务领域中，DoF 揭示了组织效应的层次结构。委派粒度和机制内部的路由产生了结构化但有界的特征分布。
tldr: 该论文提出了“自由度”这一连续配置框架，通过量化委派给下游智能体的决策空间大小，在集中式与去中心化协调机制之间实现系统性调节，并揭示了多智能体系统中不同层次的组织效应。
en_tdlr: This paper introduces Degrees of Freedom (DoF), a continuous configuration framework that quantifies the decision space delegated to downstream agents, enabling systematic exploration between centralized and decentralized coordination regimes and revealing a hierarchy of organizational effects in LLM-based multi-agent systems.
